visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women wearing mouse-ear headbands are positioned centrally on a red-tiled outdoor walkway at night. The woman on the left is dressed in a blue oversized denim shirt featuring massive, vibrant red fuzzy faux-fur sleeves, paired with black leggings and knee-high white shaggy boots. The woman on the right wears a black-and-white patterned zip-up jacket over a black mini skirt, black leggings, and tan shaggy boots. They perform a highly synchronized dance routine involving rhythmic swaying, overhead arm circles, and playful hand gestures while smiling brightly at the camera. The background depicts a brightly lit theme park street with festive Christmas decorations, string lights, and a large evergreen tree. Several indistinct figures of park visitors are visible in the distance under the warm, glowing artificial streetlights.
